requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains a structural concern-mixing issue (functional action + quality criterion). Decomposed into one functional requirement (send email) and one quality requirement (30-second response time) per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer
structured_requirements.final_statement: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Response time constraint moved to separate quality requirement.

fields.condition: after a customer submits an order

structured_requirements.final_statement: The confirmation email shall be delivered to the customer within 30 seconds of the order submission.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
